description: A number key and a string key with the same text name the same attribute
notes: The spec doesn't say what happens when two elements of an object constructor produce the same attribute name. Object types can't have two attributes with the same name, and a for expression that produces a duplicate key is an error. hashicorp/hcl keeps the value of the last element without any diagnostic (ObjectConsExpr.Value in hclsyntax/expression.go).
